title: Italian Feta Crumble
description: A twist on the classic Italian cheese dish, featuring crumbled feta cheese and a crunchy topping.
instructions: In a large bowl, combine the cubed bread, crumbled feta cheese, and shredded Italian cheese.
In a small bowl, mix together the chopped parsley and breadcrumbs.
Add the parsley and breadcrumb mixture to the bread mixture and toss to combine.
Transfer the mixture to a baking dish and bake for 20-25 minutes, or until the top is golden brown and the bread is crispy.
